purpose: Turn current match live_state plus optional hard-data, captured Master+ Ranking Overlay evidence, user-context, and previous-advice context into interrupt-gated cruise advice tasks.
non_goals: Do not encode fixed TFT/JCC strategy as mandatory rules.
Do not treat glossary terms as the strategy source.

input_contract.hp_authority_policy: An active-match HP value less than or equal to zero is missing/invalid unless explicit elimination or match-ended evidence is present. HP zero alone must not suppress coaching as match_eliminated or trigger emergency advice.
decision_source_order: current-Match captured Zhangmeng/Tencent Master+ Ranking Overlay evidence
user preferences and current-match confirmed variables

conditional_decision_policy.purpose: Expose a compact default line, material overrides, exit conditions, and the immediate action without adding another model call.

without_durable_target.stage_2: rank two or three candidate directions from augments, equipment, own cards, economy, HP, and rankings; state entry conditions and remain flexible when evidence is weak
without_durable_target.after_3_2: narrow to one primary and one backup; state carry, tank, roll level, and what the next major choice can still change
without_durable_target.stage_3_5_to_3_7: recommend relative convergence or explicitly justify waiting for the next major choice; one nonblocking preference question is allowed
without_durable_target.after_4_2: commit to execution or pivot from HP, economy, target cost curve, current cap, and final major-choice fit

lineup_convergence_agenda.with_durable_target: do not reopen generic candidate discovery; before 4-2 use ordinary target-fit decisions, and from 4-2 onward proactively validate continue versus exit conditions plus the immediate roll, level, economy, item, or transition action
lineup_convergence_agenda.season_policy: active-season choice implications come only from the compiled major-season descriptor

special_context_visual_probe.purpose: Acquire a missing season-mechanic fact when the user-visible effect panel is available.
special_context_visual_probe.rule: This task may request scoped fact acquisition, but it must not create a visible cruise answer or bypass the normal manual and sensing boundaries.

choice_advice_tasks.major_season_migration: A new major-season choice becomes scoreable by declaring its descriptor; common scorer and contract files must not add a season-specific trigger id.

stage_adaptive_lineup_fit.later_stage_policy: Use the registered stage profiles exactly. Keep confirmed augment fit material while increasing executable board and tempo evidence after stage 2.
stage_adaptive_lineup_fit.candidate_pool_policy: Score the complete lightweight eligible Master+ candidate pool before truncation. Typed target, augment, board, equipment, intent, shop, and meta indexes annotate evidence coverage only and must not introduce a second numerical business ranking.
stage_adaptive_lineup_fit.single_score_policy: The five registered components form the only business score. After hard target-role and formed-durable-core constraints, deterministic ties resolve by stable lineup id rather than an extra meta, readiness, lane-count, or shop vote.
stage_adaptive_lineup_fit.board_commitment_policy: current_board_fit uses owned board and bench only. Main carry, main tank, multiple core matches, copies, and upgrades raise commitment confidence; an ordinary one-star transition unit remains low confidence. Shop units never contribute to this component.
stage_adaptive_lineup_fit.shop_policy: Shop matches remain immediate opportunity evidence for buy, hold, lock, or transition actions and contribute zero to lineup score until owned.
stage_adaptive_lineup_fit.target_role_policy: Explicit user role intent is a constraint ahead of the weighted fit score. A main-carry target cannot be satisfied by a member-only match.
stage_adaptive_lineup_fit.stage_readiness_policy: Evaluate every candidate through one season-neutral lifecycle readiness assessment instead of separate fee pools. It labels provisional observation, conditional start, future target, build-toward, or formed-core continuation. Readiness is an interpretation and continuity constraint, not a hidden sixth percentage. Temporary stage-2 low-cost pairs never create a durable target; a formed durable core is not replaced by an unrelated higher-cost meta line without explicit exit evidence.
stage_adaptive_lineup_fit.contest_policy: Hero popularity is a low-weight warning in stage 2 and 3 and a medium constraint once the player is committing; it is never a live opponent count.
stage_adaptive_lineup_fit.missing_choice_policy: Only the exact current choice question may treat its candidate facts as blocking. Other user-owned actions answer first and carry missing augment or descriptor-owned season choices as conditional uncertainty or reminders.

augment_choice_evaluator.ownership: season-neutral Runtime evaluator over Match-pinned Core augment profiles and current facts
augment_choice_evaluator.candidate_scope: the exact newest current-match user-reported augment choice set, each candidate exactly once
augment_choice_evaluator.objective_semantics: Derived decision-fit scores for the current facts, never observed top-four or first-place probabilities.
augment_choice_evaluator.lineup_association_policy: Daily recipe associations are supporting compatibility evidence only. Compute them from the candidate lineup's normalized meta/board/item/tempo baseline with augment_fit excluded, and count one associated augment at most once per atomic lineup.
augment_choice_evaluator.no_target_policy: When no target exists, do not invent lineup fit. Prefer current realization, flexibility, generality, immediate stabilization, growth, payout timing, and risk.
augment_choice_evaluator.ranking_unavailable_policy: Evaluate from the captured Core Profile and current facts only. Do not fall back to popular recipes, another season, or stale rankings.
augment_choice_evaluator.host_boundary: The evaluator supplies ordered evidence. The Host owns the final explanation and may reorder only when it cites a typed current-fact reason absent from or newer than the evaluator input.

target_plan.use: Owned board and bench facts may increase current_board_fit and lineup commitment when they directly advance the current target or transition plan. Shop facts are unowned immediate opportunities only: they may create buy, hold, lock, or transition actions, but never increase lineup score or commitment until purchased.

hard_data_context.preferred_source: the active Core Profile's flat typed and route lookup indexes
hard_data_context.use: Add entity-axis evidence such as immediate_power, cap_power, economy, tempo, frontline, backline_damage, utility, sustain, control, positioning, pivot, and risk. These are weights and evidence, not patch-truth overrides.

ranking_overlay_context.preferred_source: the immutable Master+ Ranking Overlay captured by Start Match and selected through typed artifacts
ranking_overlay_context.use: Use only compatible Zhangmeng/Tencent Master+ typed evidence captured for this Match. When rankings are unavailable, use live_state and the captured Core Profile without a foreign-version substitute.

user_context.use: Bias style and constraints, such as play_to_win, hard-force preference, or willingness to pivot. User preference cannot override current match survival or patch truth.

previous_advice_state.use: Suppress repeated cruise advice while the trigger cooldown is active. This keeps cruise mode proactive without becoming noisy.

source_order: current-Match captured Master+ Ranking Overlay evidence when available
combat_cap_estimator.use: Fast first-pass estimate for current own board power and eventual cap gap. This is not full combat simulation; it gates whether the agent should stabilize from own-state evidence, preserve economy, pivot, or plan for a higher-cap line. It must not depend on opponent board unit sensing. The season-neutral lineup lifecycle and board-readiness fields constrain cost-curve mistakes such as a normal level-seven large roll for a four-cost carry.

lineup_lifecycle.use: Common cost-curve and board-readiness priors. Treat preferred and discouraged actions as conditional evidence, not fixed timing rules. Only truly impossible or unsupported actions belong in forbidden_actions. Current HP, economy, XP, board readiness, copy progress, contest pressure, target structure, current patch/rank-bracket data, active-season variables, and explicit user direction determine whether an override is justified.
